bias.en: Downtrend · rejected at $588, lowest close since Nov 5
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 在 $588 受阻，11月5日以来最低收盘

read.en: Lumentum fell 2.9% on Nov 19 to $535.15, fading from a $587.69 high to a $531.01 low on light volume (0.61x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($557.8), 10-day ($578.2), 30-day ($744.5) and 100-day ($829.7), all falling, and the 200-day ($816.3, rising). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($694.27), and RSI is 34.4.
read.zh: Lumentum 11月19日下跌 2.9%，收于 $535.15，自 $587.69 高点回落至 $531.01 低点，成交量偏低（为 20 日均量的 0.61 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$557.8）、10 日（$578.2）、30 日（$744.5）和 100 日均线（$829.7）下方，四者均在下行，也低于 200 日均线（$816.3，上行）。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$694.27），RSI 为 34.4。

read.en: The $587.69 high was rejected above the 10-day and the close broke the $537.1–538.6 support (Nov 18 low, Nov 6 close), now resistance; the $531.01 low undercut the Nov 17 low ($534.69). Resistance is $537.1–546 (Nov 9 low, Nov 16 close), then $551.1–560 (Nov 18 close, 5-day) and $578.2–587.7 (10-day, Nov 18–19 highs). Support is $531–534.7, then $518 and $506.7–509.7 (Nov 5). A close above $546 would target $558; below $531, $518.
